# forumulate_space_locale (Resource)

A language a docs space publishes in. Adding one gives every page a translatable twin at a locale-prefixed address (`/docs/es/...`) and is the prerequisite for hand-written and machine translations. The code `default` relabels the source language (shown as "Original" until you name it); it exists already, so it is only renamed, and destroying it changes nothing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "forumulate_space_locale" "es" {
  space_id = forumulate_space.docs.id
  code     = "es"
  label    = "Español"
}

# The source language is only relabelled.
resource "forumulate_space_locale" "source" {
  space_id = forumulate_space.docs.id
  code     = "default"
  label    = "English"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) The language code (2 to 20 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, like `es` or `pt-br`), or `default`. It is the translation's address, so changing it replaces the resource.
- `label` (String) The name shown in the reader's language switcher, 1 to 80 characters.
- `space_id` (String) The docs space (its id or slug). Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<space_id>/<code>`.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the space's source language.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import forumulate_space_locale.es docs/es
```
